title: A generator that cannot be built stops at construction, even for a generate with no rows
proves: a generator whose argument names a per-row value (max=this.limit, max=this['limit'] or a colon name such as max=this.ns:cap) cannot resolve at construction and is built on the first row: the deferral is kept for exactly that case
a generator with an unknown argument or a syntax error stops with I832 before any row is generated, so a generate with count=0 no longer hides it
